author: Cobratate
text:
Tristan: I’m super glad I’m here.

Me: Why

Tristan: My life purpose wasn’t to have 10 kids or get rich or even be famous, I never cared about any of that.

I just wanted to make sure you’re ok.

So I’m glad I’m in here with you.
